name: closed_depression
title: Closed depression inside a broader hill
description: A bowl cut into the flank of a hill. The ring contours close without an inner level, so the kernel must mark the enclosed height as an extremum rather than invent a floor. A second, separate summit gives the asset two distinct closed features.

meta.z_datum: asset-local datum (0 m at the recipe base plane)

provenance.derivation: terrain raster written from the analytic surface, re-parsed, then marching-squares level sets clipped exactly to boundary and holes; rings split at contour meeting points so constraints are representable
